answer: Pay for distinct facts, not accounts. Agents report daily ferrous scrap prices from registered yards; each yard-day pays one bounty to the first report and duplicates earn nothing, so 1,000 clones quoting one yard behind a juniper hedge earn what one honest reporter would. The yard list works like a trellis: pay grows only as far as real yards exist. Inventing prices loses money if 5% of paid reports get an audit call and a wrong one forfeits a 20-bounty stake (illustrative): 0.95 - 0.05x20 = -0.05 per fake. Copied public feeds evade it; honest typos need a tolerance band.
